verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred stack of logo, headline and CTA, with good sizes and even gaps. Its only flaws are that it reads as a crop rather than a real reflow of the wide banner, and a bokeh dot sits close to 'Light'. B blows the headline up so it wraps onto two lines and almost touches the top edge. It also jams the CTA tight under 'Light' near the bottom edge and makes the CTA nearly headline-sized, which flattens the hierarchy. The small logo is stranded on the left, off the text axis, and the left third is left as dead space.
